description: Compute Body Mass Index and its weight classification from height and weight alone. Adults use the WHO cutoffs (underweight / normal / overweight / obese); for ages 2–19 pass age + sex and it uses the CDC BMI-for-age percentiles instead. Returns a canonical myplate.food URL and source citation.

age.description: Age in years (2–120). Omit for standard adult BMI; required (with sex) for ages 2–19 youth percentiles. Under 2 there is no BMI reference — weight status is assessed on weight-for-length.

height_cm.description: Height in centimeters (or use height_ft + height_in).

sex.description: Required only when age < 20 (CDC curves are sex-specific).

name: calculate_bmi
title: Calculate BMI (Body Mass Index)
